rule: A closing rank is the last rank admitted in the FINAL round of last year's official counselling, for the Open category, gender-neutral seats, in the quota named. It is shown only when status is 'checked' — read off the official result page (source_url) by a person or by the study bot with an admin's approval. Every shown rank carries the caveat that it changes every year and differs by category, quota and seat pool, with a link to the official archive. Draft rows are never shown; 'reported' keeps what search summaries said, for the checker only.

review.note: Built in a session that could not open the official result sites (josaa.nic.in, mcc.nic.in and the CLAT consortium were blocked from the build container). Search summaries gave conflicting numbers, so every row starts as a draft. The study bot checks them on the official sites from August to October and proposes each value in Data updates.

josaa.name: JoSAA — opening and closing ranks (IITs, NITs, IIITs)
josaa.how: by JEE Advanced rank (IITs) or JEE Main rank (NITs, IIITs), per round, category, quota and seat pool

mcc.name: MCC — NEET UG all-India quota allotments
mcc.how: by NEET UG rank, per round, category and quota; state-quota seats are counselled by each state

clat.name: Consortium of NLUs — CLAT allotment lists
clat.how: by CLAT rank, per allotment list, category and domicile

iim.name: IIM CAT — each IIM's own admission criteria
iim.how: no single closing rank: each IIM shortlists by CAT percentile, then selects on a written test, interview and profile

design.name: UCEED (IIT design) and NID DAT results
design.how: UCEED rank for the IIT B.Des programmes; NID selects on DAT prelims and mains

nchm.name: NCHM JEE — NCHMCT counselling
nchm.how: by NCHM JEE rank, per round and category
